prediction: Huawei Ascend 950-series chips will capture more than 40% of new AI accelerator orders placed by ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent combined by end of Q3 2026, as measured by publicly reported procurement volumes or analyst estimates.
evidence: DeepSeek V4 launched optimized exclusively for Huawei Ascend 950 hardware, triggering immediate mass procurement rushes from all three Chinese hyperscalers. China blocked Nvidia H200 purchases despite US export approval, confirmed by Trump post-Beijing summit. Structural decoupling from Nvidia now has both supply-side (export controls) and demand-side (DeepSeek optimization) acceleration. Huawei supply chain bottlenecks remain the key risk.
resolution_criteria: Resolved TRUE if any credible analyst report (IDC, TrendForce, Bernstein, SemiAnalysis) or official company disclosures indicate Huawei Ascend-series chips represent >40% of AI accelerator procurement by ByteDance+Alibaba+Tencent in aggregate for Q3 2026. Resolved FALSE if share remains below 40% or if procurement data is unavailable by 2026-11-30.
falsification_condition: US-China diplomatic breakthrough restores Nvidia H200/H20 access to Chinese hyperscalers at scale before Q3 2026 ends, causing ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent to revert to Nvidia-primary procurement.
